 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real Madrid host Celta Vigo in the first game after the two-week FIFA break and this is the match every fan was waiting for. Will Diomande keep his spot as a starter now that Vinicius is back from his suspension? Outlets like COPE or AS are expecting Vinicius to start, but will Mourinho send that kind of message now that he's found his Gala XI?
 PREDICTED LINEUPS 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Real Madrid predicted XI: Courtois; Valverde, Militao, Rüdiger, Cucurella; Tchouaméni, Bernardo; Bellingham, Güler, Diomande; Mbappé.
 Celta Vigo predicted XI: Radu; Javi Rodríguez, Yoel Lago, Marcos Alonso; Javi Rueda, Aleix Febas, Moriba, Carreira; Swedberg, Jutglà y Hugo Álvarez.
 HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGA 
 Date: 11/21/2026
 Time: 21:00 CET, 03:00pm EST.
 Venue: Santiago Bernabeu, Madrid, Spain.
 Available TV: DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).
 Available Streaming: ESPN+ (USA)
